items.title: Icons, Round Two
items.why:
These are the nine icons you asked to change, with your notes. Each one shows your earlier pick as "Your last pick", then two new drawings.

Your own rule is no copyrighted images, so these are original nods to Dragon Ball drawn from scratch: an island house rather than the Kame House design, a spiky-haired figure rather than Goku himself, and a capsule with a button rather than the Capsule Corp logo.

Already approved and going into 2.20: drumstick for Protein, stopwatch for Workout, heart with a pulse for Check-In, clock with a back arrow for History, gear for Settings, calendar with days for Week, and drawn arrows. Library and Water stay as they are.
